blocks.text: Singer-songwriter Hayley Williams has sent Asian music fans into high gear after seemingly teasing a 2027 Asian leg for her ongoing solo tour, “The Hayley Williams Show.” Speculation caught fire online following a YouTube livestream that featured a billboard over Tokyo’s famed Shibuya Crossing set to her track “Dream Girl in Shibuya.” The brief visual teaser flashed potential 2027 tour dates across four major Asian cities, kicking off in Manila on February 24, followed by Singapore on February 26, Seoul on March 1, and concluding in Tokyo on March 3.
